name: toast
title: Toast
description: Brief, non-blocking notifications — a stacking Base UI Toast surface with success, error, warning, info and loading types, promise toasts and swipe-to-dismiss.

meta.whenToUse: Brief confirmations of an action — 'Saved', 'Copied', 'Invitation sent' — and the loading → success/error arc of an async one.
meta.whenNotToUse: Errors the user must resolve, destructive confirmations, or essential info — use inline or a Dialog.
